name: pricewin
description: Live hotel and flight prices compared across Booking.com, Agoda, Trip.com and Traveloka, in USD, through the PriceWin MCP server. Includes the pricewin-travel-search skill. Can send a booking request to a direct-listed hotel (nothing is charged; the guest pays at the property).

interface.shortDescription: Live hotel and flight prices across OTAs
interface.longDescription: Compare live hotel and flight prices across Booking.com, Agoda, Trip.com and Traveloka, in USD, with links to book at the source. Runs on PriceWin's hosted MCP server: no account, no API key.
defaultPrompt: Compare hotel prices in Da Nang for 2 adults from November 10 to 12.
